title: He tried to scale the golden goose

lines.tts: [intrigued] This goose laid one golden egg a day. The farmer still wasn't happy.
lines.text: This goose laid one golden egg a day. The farmer still wasn't happy.

lines.tts: [hyped, loud] One egg? We're scaling, baby!
So Tod added night shifts. Weekend shifts. Motivational posters.
lines.text: So Tod added night shifts. Weekend shifts. Motivational posters.

lines.tts: [hyped] Rise and grind, Goldie! Eggs don't lay themselves!
lines.text: Rise and grind, Goldie! Eggs don't lay themselves!

lines.tts: [exhausted, dry] ...They literally do. That's the whole point.
lines.text: They literally do. That's the whole point.

lines.tts: [brisk] Week one: two eggs. Week two: one.
lines.text: Week one: two eggs. Week two: one.

lines.tts: [slow, sad] Week three... a tiny, sad, bronze egg.
lines.text: Week three... a tiny, sad, bronze egg.

lines.tts: [flat, fed up] I'm a goose. Not a damn factory.
lines.text: I'm a goose. Not a damn factory.

lines.tts: So Tod tried something insane. He let her sleep.
lines.text: So Tod tried something insane. He let her sleep.

lines.tts: [warm] Back to one golden egg a day. For years.
lines.text: Back to one golden egg a day. For years.

lines.tts: Burnout doesn't make more eggs. Rest does.
lines.text: Burnout doesn't make more eggs. Rest does.

lines.tts: [whispering, excited] Goldie... what if we started a podcast?
lines.text: Goldie... what if we started a podcast?

lines.tts: Comment REST for the free weekly rest planner.
